player_prompt.intro:
Udlala ngombala {color} kwenye umdlalo we-Breakthrough. Udlela {direction} kwenye bheti ye-{board_size}x{board_size}.
Kwenye imini yakho ungadlula ipisi elilodwa isinyathelo sasinye phambili okanye phambili ngokunxulumana.
Ipisi lingadlula ngokunxulumana kuphela ukuba ipisi leqela elikhona, lingadlula kuphela kuleyo ngingqi inokhethwa ngokunxulumana.
Ukungenela kwingingqi elikhona ipisi leqela, uyiphumelela ipisi leqela liyekwe emva kakhulu kubheti.
Sebenzisa umbhalo onje ngo-UCI, umzekelo [a2a3] ukudlula ukusuka a2 uye a3.
* 'a' inelekeza kwenye ile kholomu elikhohlo, '1' yile mstho wasezantsi (ukusuka komhlali we-White).
* Umstho wasekhaya we-Blacks ngumstho waphezulu (umstho wesishiyagalombili kwenye isishiyagalombili esingangxowa).
Umthetheli wokuqala ipisi lake lifikelela umstho wasekhaya weqela uphelele. Ukuba ipisi zakho zikhelelwe zonke, uyohluleka.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Nceda usebenzise uphawu lwe-algebra oluphakathi kwezakhelo ezifana no [a2a3].
invalid_move.illegal: Loo ntshukumo ayilandeli imithetho yokuGqobhoza okanye asiyonto yakho.

outcome.black_reached: Umbala omnyama ufikelele kumqolo wesigxina kaMhlophe.
